description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git column' command. It sets up test cases, compares expected output, and verifies behaviors of the 'git column' utility with various options and inputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified description and commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting failure; used to test invalid inputs or error conditions.
